_why: Each statistic is recomputed within each hemisphere. Hill's macaque-to-human expansion correlation does not hold sign across hemispheres and is not reported. The coverage deficit and the dissociation hold in both. Single-hemisphere spin p values are not reported, because a Haar rotation of a half-sphere is not a spin.

left._no_spin_p: A Haar rotation of a single-hemisphere point cloud folds onto a half-sphere and is not a valid spin test. Effect size only.

right._no_spin_p: A Haar rotation of a single-hemisphere point cloud folds onto a half-sphere and is not a valid spin test. Effect size only.

hill_hemisphere_reversal.verdict: Not reported: the sign is not stable across hemispheres.
